title: Claude Code statusline
description: Settings for .claude/statusline.sh, validated and set by /statusline-config. Every key is optional and falls back to its default.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor validation and completion.

theme.description: Color treatment of the whole statusline.

oneOf.description: Full color.
No colors, dim and bold only.

layout.description: Segments to render, one group per statusline line. Unknown names are dropped, and a layout left with no segment falls back to the default. Setting context.style to progress moves context onto its own line in the default layout.

oneOf.description: Repository owner/name linked to its host, or the current directory.
Current git branch.
Counts of staged, modified and deleted files.
Model display name.
Reasoning effort level.
Bolt shown only while fast mode is on.
Context window usage.
Five-hour rate limit usage and reset time.
Weekly rate limit usage and reset time.

bar.description: Usage bars drawn for the context, five-hour and weekly segments.

oneOf.description: Shaded blocks.
Braille blocks in the accent color.
Round dots in the accent color.
Shaded blocks ramped from yellow to red.
Pacman eating pellets.

trail.description: Leave small dots behind the pacman head instead of spaces. Pacman style only.

style.description: How the effort level is drawn.

oneOf.description: Level word tinted like the CLI effort picker.
Level word with no color.
Model picker glyph in the Claude orange.

style.description: Where and how the context usage is drawn.

oneOf.description: Token count next to the model.
Labeled bar on its own line.

warn.description: How a filling context window is flagged.

oneOf.description: No warning, the token count stays dim.
Tint the token count yellow, orange, then red as it fills up.
Append the icon in that same yellow, orange, then red.
Tint the token count and append the icon.

icon.description: Icon appended when warn is icon or both.
